hero.title: Antony Araújo.
hero.subtitle: I develop solutions for the web.
hero.description: As a Software Engineer, I create end-to-end digital solutions. My expertise ranges from developing user interfaces with React and Next.js to building robust APIs and backend systems with Node.js, Java, and PHP.

items.description: I develop and maintain an Auto-Configuration System (ACS), creating both the backend APIs for device management and the frontend interfaces with React to optimize the user experience.
I was involved in the development of complete solutions for government projects and internal products, creating APIs for data processing and building interfaces with interactive maps and dashboards.

As an IT Security Intern, I contributed to securing critical corporate systems by focusing on network infrastructure and access control. I managed user permissions through LDAP directory services and assisted in FortiNet firewall administration.
